channel.title: Senegal - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Senegal, every source cited.

item.title: Moody's downgrades Senegal's foreign currency debt rating
item.description: The rating agency lowered the long-term foreign currency debt rating from Caa2 to Ca, citing expected higher losses for external private creditors.

item.title: Senegal doctors see stroke patients after eight-year waits
item.description: Saint-Louis health centre offered free consultations for stroke victims on October 29, 2026.

item.title: Senegal releases 30 detained at MFDC Casamance headquarters
item.description: Authorities freed 30 individuals arrested during the Tuesday dismantling of the MFDC political wing's base in Ziguinchor.

item.title: Refugee athlete to compete at Dakar Youth Games
item.description: Arno Yafunga Botay will represent the Refugee Olympic Team in judo at the 2026 games.
